articles.summary: Sonnet 5 delivers frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale.
articles.body_preview: Claude Sonnet 5 is built to be the most agentic Sonnet model yet. It can make plans, use tools like browsers and terminals, and run autonomously at a level that, just a few months ago, required larger and more expensive models.
